causalChain.action: Traders execute short selling of spot shares from a custodian and collect cash proceeds.
causalChain.mechanism: Lenders receive any intermediate dividends while cash compounds at risk-free rate r.
causalChain.result: Traders take forward delivery at K to return borrowed stock at expiration.
causalChain.consequence: Net guaranteed profit enforces the lower no-arbitrage pricing boundary.
